script_text: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil. And when He had fasted forty days and forty nights, afterward He was hungry. Now when the tempter came to Him, he said, «If You are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.» But He answered and said, «It is written, «Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds from the mouth of God.»́ Then the devil took Him up into the holy city, set Him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to Him, «If You are the Son of God, throw Yourself down. For it is written: «He shall give His angels charge over you,́ and, «In their hands they shall bear you up, Lest you dash your foot against a stone.»́
style_suffix: The illustration style features a warm, earthy palette dominated by browns, ochres, and muted greens, evoking a sense of ancient wilderness and spiritual depth. Soft, diffused lighting mimics the natural glow of oil lamps and the gentle illumination of daylight filtering through trees, creating a serene yet dramatic atmosphere. The brushwork is textured and organic, with visible strokes that enhance the tactile quality of stone, wood, and fabric, bringing the ancient world to life. The camera mood is contemplative and reverent, capturing intimate moments of reflection and struggle against expansive backdrops of rugged landscapes or grand temple architecture. Careful attention is given to authenticity, ensuring that all elements—clothing, tools, and settings—are period-appropriate, while avoiding any modern artifacts or anachronisms that would disrupt the historical integrity of the scenes. Horizontal 16:9 landscape, no text, no watermark, no logos, no book-with-text compositions.
